en.t: Baldwin IX, Count of Flanders is crowned as the first Emperor of the Latin Empire
en.s: Baldwin I (Dutch: Boudewijn; French: Baudouin; July 1172 – c. 1205) was the first Emperor of the Latin Empire of Constantinople; Count of Flanders (as Baldwin IX) from 1194 to 1205 and Count of Hainaut (as Baldwin VI) from 1195 to 1205. Baldwin was one of the most prominent leaders of the Fourth Crusade, which resulted in the sack of Constantinople in 1204, the conquest of the Byzantine Empire, and the foundation of the Latin Empire.

zh.t: 佛兰德伯爵鲍德温九世加冕为拉丁帝国首任皇帝
zh.s: 鲍德温一世（荷兰语：Boudewijn；法语：Baudouin；1172年7月—约1205年）是君士坦丁堡拉丁帝国首任皇帝；他还于1194年至1205年担任佛兰德伯爵鲍德温九世，并于1195年至1205年担任埃诺伯爵鲍德温六世。他是第四次十字军东征的重要领袖之一；该东征导致1204年君士坦丁堡遭洗劫、拜占庭帝国被征服以及拉丁帝国建立。

en.s: The Battle of Cocherel was fought on 16 May 1364 between the forces of Charles V of France and the forces of Charles II of Navarre (known as Charles the Bad) under the command of Bertrand du Guesclin, over the succession to the Kingdom of France. The result was a French victory.

zh.s: 科克勒尔战役于1364年5月16日爆发。法国国王查理五世的军队与纳瓦拉国王查理二世（绰号“恶人查理”）的部队交战，后者由贝特朗·杜·盖克兰指挥。双方争夺法国王位继承权，最终法军获胜。

en.t: Gov. Thado of Mohnyin becomes King of Ava
en.s: Mohnyin Thado (Burmese: မိုးညှင်း သတိုး, pronounced [móɲ̥ɪ́ɴ ðədó]; Shan: မိူင်းယၢင်းထၢတ်ႈဢူး, Mongyang That Oo; 1379–1439) was king of Ava from 1426 to 1439. He is also known in Burmese history as Mohnyin Min Taya (မိုးညှင်း မင်းတရား, [móɲ̥ɪ́ɴ mɪ́ɴ təjá], "Righteous Lord of Mohnyin") after his longtime tenure as the sawbwa of Mohnyin, a Shan-speaking frontier state (in present-day Kachin State, Myanmar).

zh.t: 莫欣总督达多继位为阿瓦国王
zh.s: 莫欣达多（缅甸语：မိုးညှင်း သတိုး，读音：[móɲ̥ɪ́ɴ ðədó]；掸语：မိူင်းယၢင်းထၢတ်ႈဢူး，Mongyang That Oo；1379—1439年）于1426年至1439年担任阿瓦国王。他在缅甸史料中也称莫欣明塔亚（မိုးညှင်း မင်းတရား，意为“莫欣的正义之主”），这是他长期担任莫欣诏法（掸语区边境邦，今缅甸克钦邦）的称号后获得的称呼。

en.t: Sir Thomas More resigns as Lord Chancellor of England
en.s: Sir Thomas More (7 February 1478 – 6 July 1535), venerated in the Catholic Church as a martyr and saint, was an English lawyer, judge, social philosopher, author, statesman, theologian and Renaissance humanist. He also served Henry VIII as Lord Chancellor from October 1529 to May 1532. He wrote Utopia, published in 1516, which describes the political system of an imaginary island state.

zh.t: 托马斯·莫尔爵士辞去英格兰大法官职务
zh.s: 托马斯·莫尔爵士（1478年2月7日—1535年7月6日）是英国律师、法官、政治哲学家、作家、政治家、神学家和文艺复兴时期的人文主义者，后被天主教会尊为殉道者和圣人。他于1529年10月至1532年5月担任亨利八世的大法官。他的著作《乌托邦》于1516年出版，描绘了一个虚构岛国的政治制度。

en.t: Mary, Queen of Scots, flees to England
en.s: Mary, Queen of Scots (8 December 1542 – 8 February 1587), also known as Mary Stuart or Mary I of Scotland, was Queen of Scotland from 14 December 1542 until her forced abdication on 24 July 1567. The only surviving legitimate child of King James V of Scotland, Mary was six days old when her father died, and she inherited the throne.

zh.t: 苏格兰女王玛丽逃往英格兰
zh.s: 苏格兰女王玛丽（1542年12月8日—1587年2月8日），又称玛丽·斯图亚特或苏格兰的玛丽一世，1542年12月14日起担任苏格兰女王，直至1567年7月24日被迫退位。她是苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世唯一存活的婚生子女；父亲去世时她只有6天大，随后继承王位。

en.s: The Kandyan naval raid was a series of commerce raidings by the Kingdom of Kandy against the Portuguese Empire from 16 May 1612 to 6 March 1613. With the help of Dutch envoy Marcellus de Bochouwer, King Senarat of Kandy commissioned a fleet of 3 war galleys and 3 yachts under the Admiralty of a nephew of Kuruvita Rala, the prince of Uva.

zh.t: 康提王国对葡萄牙的海上劫掠（1612—1613年）
zh.s: 康提王国于1612年5月16日至1613年3月6日对葡萄牙帝国发动一系列海上贸易袭击。荷兰使节马塞勒斯·德博舒沃的协助下，康提国王塞纳拉特组建了一支舰队，包括3艘战船和3艘游艇，由乌瓦亲王库鲁维塔·拉拉的一名侄子担任海军司令。

en.s: The Battle of Stratton, also known as the Battle of Stamford Hill, took place on 16 May 1643, at Stratton in Cornwall, during the First English Civil War. In the battle, the Royalists destroyed the Parliamentarians' field army in Devon and Cornwall.

zh.s: 斯特拉顿战役又称斯坦福山战役，于1643年5月16日在英国内战期间于康沃尔郡斯特拉顿爆发。王党军在战斗中摧毁了议会军在德文郡和康沃尔郡的野战部队。

en.s: This battle took place on 16 May 1644 during the Danish-Swedish War near List Deep, between Sylt and Rømø in western Denmark. Nine Danish ships under King Christian IV forced a retreat back into List Deep of 26 smaller Dutch ships (13 under Marten Thijsen and 13 under Hendrik Gerritsen) which had been leased to Sweden. 4 more Dutch ships from Marcus' squadron appeared during the battle but took no part.

zh.s: 这场战斗于1644年5月16日在丹麦西部、叙尔特岛和罗姆岛之间的利斯特深水海域爆发，是丹麦—瑞典战争的一部分。克里斯蒂安四世率领9艘丹麦战船，迫使26艘较小的荷兰船只撤回利斯特深水海域；这些荷兰船只租给了瑞典，其中13艘由马尔滕·泰森指挥，另13艘由亨德里克·赫里特森指挥。交战期间，马库斯舰队另有4艘荷兰船赶到，但未参战。

en.s: The Battle of Zhovti Vody or Yellow Waters (Ukrainian: Битва під Жовтими Водами; Polish: Bitwa pod Żołtymi Wodami; 29 April — 16 May 1648) was the first significant battle of the Khmelnytsky Uprising.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 若夫提沃迪战役又称黄水之战（乌克兰语：Битва під Жовтими Водами；波兰语：Bitwa pod Żołtymi Wodami），于1648年4月29日至5月16日进行，是赫梅利尼茨基起义中的第一场重要战役。

en.s: This battle, which took place on 16 May 1654, was the first of a series of tough battles just inside the mouth of the Dardanelles Strait, as Venice and sometimes the other Christian forces attempted to hold the Turks back from their invasion of Crete by attacking them early. The battle saw an Ottoman armada routing a much smaller Venetian fleet.

zh.s: 这场战斗于1654年5月16日爆发，是一系列激烈海战中的第一场，发生在达达尼尔海峡入口内侧。威尼斯及其他基督教势力试图阻挡土耳其人入侵克里特岛，采取的办法是在其舰队进入海峡时提前攻击。奥斯曼舰队在此战中击溃了规模小得多的威尼斯舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Zsarnóca took place on May 16, 1664, between an Austrian division commanded by General Jean-Louis Raduit de Souches with 11,000 troops and an Ottoman division commanded by Kücsük Mehmed Pasha with 15,000 troops. The battle ended in an Austrian victory and death of Kücsük Mehmed Pasha who fell in battle.

zh.s: 扎尔诺察战役于1664年5月16日爆发。奥地利军队由让-路易·拉杜伊·德·苏什将军率领，共11,000人；奥斯曼军队由屈楚克·穆罕默德帕夏率领，共15,000人。奥军获胜，屈楚克·穆罕默德帕夏也在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Loup Hill was a battle fought on the steep slopes of Loup Hill (Scottish Gaelic: Cruach na Luib), near Clachan, Kintyre, Argyll and Bute, Scotland on 16 May 1689 between Jacobite forces commanded by Donald MacNeill of Gallchoille and government forces commanded by Captain William Young. The battle was part of the Kintyre Rising in 1689 as part of the Jacobite rising.

zh.s: 卢普山战役于1689年5月16日在苏格兰阿盖尔-比特的金泰尔克拉昌附近爆发。雅各派军队由加尔乔伊尔的唐纳德·麦克尼尔指挥，政府军由威廉·杨上尉率领。此战是1689年金泰尔起义期间雅各派起义的一部分。卢普山的苏格兰盖尔语名为Cruach na Luib。

en.s: The Battle of Vasai or the Battle of Bassein was fought between the Maratha Empire and the Portuguese rulers of Vasai (Portuguese, Baçaim; English, Bassein), a town near Mumbai (Bombay) in the Konkan region of the present-day state of Maharashtra, India. The Marathas were led by Chimaji Appa, a brother of Peshwa Baji Rao I.
en.n: The Battle of Vasai concludes as the Marathas defeat the Portuguese army.

zh.s: 瓦赛战役又称巴塞因战役，是马拉塔帝国与葡萄牙统治者之间的一场战斗，争夺今印度马哈拉施特拉邦科康地区、孟买附近的瓦赛镇（葡萄牙语：Baçaim；英语：Bassein）。马拉塔军由奇马吉·阿帕率领，他是佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥一世的兄弟。
zh.n: 马拉塔军击败葡萄牙军队，瓦赛战役结束。

en.s: The Mughal–Persian wars or Mughal–Iranian wars were a series of wars fought in the 16th, 17th and 18th centuries between the Safavid and Afsharid Empires of Persia, and the Mughal Empire of India, over what is now Afghanistan. The Mughals consolidated their control of what is today India and Pakistan in the 16th century, and gradually came into conflict with the powerful Safavids and Afsharids, led by Abbas the Great and Nader Shah respectively.

zh.s: 莫卧儿—波斯战争是16、17和18世纪萨法维王朝、阿夫沙尔王朝与印度莫卧儿帝国之间围绕今阿富汗地区展开的一系列战争。16世纪，莫卧儿帝国巩固了对今印度和巴基斯坦的控制，随后逐渐与强大的萨法维和阿夫沙尔王朝发生冲突，后两者分别由阿拔斯大帝和纳迪尔沙统治。

en.s: The Battle of Pointe-aux-Trembles was a naval and land engagement during the conquest of New France that took place on 16 May 1760 on the north shore of the Saint Lawrence River, near the future site of Neuville, Quebec, Canada. In the previous September, the British had occupied the city of Quebec in New France, and starting in April a French force had been besieging the city.

zh.s: 特朗布勒角战役于1760年5月16日在新法兰西征服战争期间爆发，是一场海陆交战，地点在圣劳伦斯河北岸、加拿大魁北克省未来的讷维尔附近。此前一年9月，英国已占领新法兰西的魁北克城；自4月起，法军开始围攻该城。

en.t: The 14-year-old Marie Antoinette marries 15-year-old Louis-Auguste, Dauphin de France, who later becomes king of France
en.s: Marie Antoinette (Marie Antoinette Josèphe Jeanne; 2 November 1755 – 16 October 1793) was Queen of France as the wife of Louis XVI from 10 May 1774 until the abolition of the French monarchy in 1792 during the French Revolution. Born in November 1755 at the Hofburg in Vienna, Marie Antoinette was the fifteenth child and youngest daughter of Emperor Francis I and Empress Maria Theresa.

zh.t: 14岁的玛丽·安托瓦内特与15岁的法国王太子路易-奥古斯特成婚，后者成为法国国王
zh.s: 玛丽·安托瓦内特（Marie Antoinette Josèphe Jeanne；1755年11月2日—1793年10月16日）是路易十六的妻子，1774年5月10日起担任法国王后，直至法国大革命期间君主制于1792年被废除。她于1755年11月出生在维也纳霍夫堡，是弗朗茨一世皇帝和玛丽亚·特蕾莎女皇的第十五个孩子，也是最小的女儿。

en.s: The Battle of Alamance took place on May 16, 1771. It was the final confrontation of the Regulator Movement in colonial North Carolina. The rebellion was instigated because of various issues with the colonial government, and was primarily aimed at needed reforms to the Currency Act. Regulator supporters demanded other changes, including an end to the corruption of local politicians, a right to secret ballot voting, land reforms, and transparency in government. Named after the nearby Great Alamance Creek, the battle took place in what was then Orange County (and now located in Alamance County) in the Piedmont area, about 6 miles (9.7 km) south of present-day Burlington, North Carolina).

zh.s: 阿拉曼斯战役于1771年5月16日爆发，是北卡罗来纳殖民地监管者运动的最后一场冲突。起义由殖民政府的多项问题引发，主要诉求是改革《货币法》。监管者运动支持者还要求改革地方官员腐败问题、实行秘密投票、改革土地制度并提高政府透明度。战役以附近的大阿拉曼斯溪命名，发生在当时的奥兰治县（今阿拉曼斯县），位于皮埃蒙特地区、今伯灵顿以南约6英里（9.7公里）处。

en.s: The Battle of Portevent’s Mill was fought between Patriot militia and Loyalist militia near present day Garland, North Carolina in Sampson County, on May 16, 1781 during the American War of Independence Patriot scouts were combing the area and discovered Loyalist soldiers under the command of Captain Middleton Mobley encamped at Portevent’s Mill grinding corn. They returned to their commander, Colonel James Kenan, and had informed him of their discovery.

zh.s: 波特文特磨坊战役于1781年5月16日在美国独立战争期间爆发，交战双方是爱国者民兵和效忠派民兵，地点在今北卡罗来纳州萨姆普森县加兰附近。当时，爱国者侦察兵正在周边搜查，发现米德尔顿·莫布利上尉率领的效忠派士兵在波特文特磨坊扎营磨玉米。他们返回营地，将发现报告给詹姆斯·基南上校。

en.s: The Action of 16 May 1797 was a naval battle that took place near Tripoli in Ottoman Tripolitania (present-day Libya). The Danish squadron was attacked by a Tripolitan squadron that outnumbered them in number of vessels.

zh.s: 1797年5月16日海战发生在奥斯曼帝国的的黎波里塔尼亚附近、今利比亚的的黎波里一带。丹麦舰队遭到规模更大的的黎波里舰队袭击。

en.s: The First Battle of Marengo or Battle of San Giuliano (16 May 1799; Julian calendar: 5 May) saw Republican French soldiers under General of Division Jean Victor Marie Moreau launch a reconnaissance in force against a larger force of Habsburg Austrian and Imperial Russian troops led by Field Marshal Alexander Suvorov. The French enjoyed initial success, pressing back their opponents.

zh.s: 第一次马伦戈战役又称圣朱利亚诺战役，于1799年5月16日爆发（儒略历：5月5日）。让-维克托·马里·莫罗少将率领共和派法军，对亚历山大·苏沃洛夫元帅指挥、人数更多的哈布斯堡奥地利和俄罗斯帝国联军发动武力侦察。法军起初进展顺利，击退了对手。

en.s: The Battle of Al Khankah was a military engagement between the Ottomans and the French army that took place near Cairo. The Ottomans defeated the French, marking the beginning of the end of the French occupation of Egypt.

zh.s: 阿尔汗卡战役是奥斯曼军队与法国军队在开罗附近的一场战斗。奥斯曼军队击败法军，标志着法国占领埃及开始走向结束。

en.s: The First Battle of Tripoli Harbor was a naval battle fought on May 16, 1802 in Tripoli Harbor between a combined force consisting of the American frigate USS Boston and two Swedish Navy frigates against several Tripolitan Barbary corsairs. The Swedish-American force was enforcing the blockade when an engagement broke out between it and Tripolitan forces.

zh.t: 第一次的黎波里港海战
zh.s: 第一次的黎波里港海战于1802年5月16日在的黎波里港爆发。美军护卫舰“波士顿号”和两艘瑞典海军护卫舰组成的联军，与多艘的黎波里巴巴里海盗船交战。美瑞联军当时正在执行封锁任务，随后与的黎波里军队爆发冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Alvøen was a sea battle of the Gunboat War between Denmark-Norway and the United Kingdom. It was fought on 16 May 1808 in Vatlestraumen, outside Bergen in Norway, between the British frigate HMS Tartar and a Norwegian force consisting of four kanonjolles and one kanonsjalupps (collectively known as gunboats).

zh.s: 阿尔沃恩海战是炮艇战争期间丹麦-挪威与英国之间的一场海战，于1808年5月16日在挪威卑尔根附近的瓦特勒海峡爆发。英军护卫舰“鞑靼人号”与一支挪威部队交战，后者由4艘炮艇和1艘炮舰组成。

en.s: The Battle of Albuera (16 May 1811) was a battle during the Peninsular War. A mixed British, Spanish and Portuguese corps engaged elements of the French Armée du Midi (Army of the South) at the small Spanish village of Albuera, about 20 kilometres (12 mi) south of the frontier fortress-town of Badajoz, Spain. From October 1810 Marshal Masséna's Army of Portugal had been tied down in an increasingly hopeless stand-off against Wellington's Allied forces, safely entrenched in and behind the Lines of Torres Vedras.

zh.s: 阿尔布埃拉战役于1811年5月16日爆发，是半岛战争期间的一场战斗。英、西、葡联军在西班牙小村阿尔布埃拉与法国南方军团的部分部队交战。该村距边境要塞巴达霍斯以南约20公里。自1810年10月起，马塞纳元帅率领的葡萄牙军团在托雷斯韦德拉什防线内外与威灵顿的盟军陷入僵持，处境日益不利。

en.t: Peninsular War: The allies Spain, Portugal and United Kingdom fight an inconclusive battle against the French at the Albuera. It is, in proportion to the numbers involved, the bloodiest battle of the war
en.s: The Peninsular War (1808–1814) was fought in the Iberian Peninsula by the Iberian nations Spain and Portugal, along with the United Kingdom, against the invading and occupying forces of the First French Empire during the Napoleonic Wars. In Spain, it is considered to overlap with the Spanish War of Independence. It overlapped with the War of the Fifth Coalition (1809) and the War of the Sixth Coalition (1812–1814).

zh.t: 半岛战争：西班牙、葡萄牙和英国联军与法军在阿尔布埃拉战成平手，这是战争中按参战人数比例计算最血腥的战役
zh.s: 半岛战争（1808—1814年）发生在伊比利亚半岛，西班牙、葡萄牙和英国联手对抗入侵并占领当地的法兰西第一帝国军队。这场战争在西班牙也被视为与西班牙独立战争重叠，并与第五次反法同盟战争（1809年）及第六次反法同盟战争（1812—1814年）同期发生。

en.s: The Little Belt affair was a naval battle off the coast of North Carolina on the night of 16 May 1811 between the United States frigate USS President and the British sixth-rate sloop-of-war HMS Little Belt. en.s: The Battle of the Smala was fought in 1843 between France and Algerian resistance fighters during the French conquest of Algeria. The French, led by Henri d'Orleans, duke of Aumale, raided the encampment (known as a smala or zmelah) of Algerian resistance leader Abd al-Qadir on 16 May 1843, while al-Qadir was absent on a raiding expedition. The 500 French cavalrymen surprised the camp defenders, who fired a single volley before scattering. More than 3,000 of al-Qadir's followers (out of a camp population of 30,000) were captured, as were many of his possessions, including his warchest and a library valued at £5,000.

en.s: Venera 5 (Russian: Венера-5 meaning Venus 5) was a space probe in the Soviet space program Venera for the exploration of Venus. Venera 5 was launched towards Venus to obtain atmospheric data. The spacecraft was very similar to Venera 4 although it was of a stronger design. The launch was conducted using a Molniya-M rocket, flying from the Baikonur Cosmodrome. When the atmosphere of Venus was approached, a capsule weighing 405 kg (893 lb) and containing scientific instruments was jettisoned from the main spacecraft. During satellite descent towards the surface of Venus, a parachute opened to slow the rate of descent. For 53 minutes on 16 May 1969, while the capsule was suspended from the parachute, data from the Venusian atmosphere were returned.

en.s: General elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 16 May 1978. Following diplomatic pressure from American President Jimmy Carter, the elections were free and competitive and contested by all political parties, unlike the previous elections in the 1970s. Antonio Guzmán Fernández won the presidential election, whilst his Dominican Revolutionary Party (which had not contested the 1970 and 1974 elections) won the Congressional elections. Voter turnout was 75.8%. However, following the election the Army attempted a coup and interrupted the vote count. Whilst American pressure allowed Guzmán to assume the presidency, the Central Elections Authority redistributed the uncast votes equally between the PRD and the Reformist Party, diminishing the PRD's majority in Congress.

zh.s: 多米尼加共和国于1978年5月16日举行大选。在美国总统吉米·卡特施压后，这次选举实现了自由竞争，各政党都能参选，与此前20世纪70年代的选举不同。安东尼奥·古斯曼·费尔南德斯当选总统；此前未参加1970年和1974年选举的多米尼加革命党赢得国会选举。投票率为75.8%。选举后，军方试图发动政变并中断计票。美国施压后，古斯曼得以就任总统，但中央选举委员会将未投出的选票平均分给革命党和改革党，削弱了革命党在国会中的多数优势。

zh.s: 1982年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛决赛于1982年5月16日在克罗克公园球场举行，决出1981—1982赛季赛事的冠军。这是全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛第12个赛季。赛事由盖尔运动协会主办，参赛俱乐部是爱尔兰四个省的冠军。

zh.s: 1987年英格兰足总杯决赛于1987年5月16日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，由考文垂城队对阵托特纳姆热刺队。这是英格兰主要足球杯赛足总杯的第106届决赛。热刺队在七年内第三次闯入决赛，此前曾于1981年和1982年夺冠；考文垂城队则是首次进入决赛。

en.s: The 1987 Scottish Cup Final was played between St Mirren and Dundee United at Hampden Park on 16 May 1987. Underdogs St Mirren won the game 1–0, with a goal by Ian Ferguson. It was their third Scottish Cup win in their then 110-year history. This was the last year, as of 2024, that the Scottish Cup has been won by a team fully composed of Scottish players.

zh.s: 1987年苏格兰杯决赛于1987年5月16日在汉普顿公园球场举行，由圣米伦队对阵邓迪联队。圣米伦作为弱队，以1比0获胜，伊恩·弗格森打入制胜球。这是圣米伦队110年队史上的第三个苏格兰杯冠军。根据截至2024年的记录，苏格兰杯此后再未由全队均为苏格兰籍球员的球队夺冠。

zh.t: 1992年英格兰足球联赛会员杯决赛
zh.s: 1992年英格兰足球联赛会员杯决赛因赞助原因称为Autoglass奖杯赛决赛，是英格兰第三级和第四级联赛球队参加的国内杯赛第九届决赛。比赛于1992年5月16日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由斯托克城队对阵斯托克波特郡队。马克·斯坦打入全场唯一进球，帮助斯托克城以1比0获胜。

en.s: Süleyman Sami Demirel (1 November 1924 – 17 June 2015) was a Turkish politician, engineer, and statesman who served as the president of Turkey from 1993 to 2000. He previously served as the prime minister of Turkey seven times between 1965 and 1993. He was the leader of the Justice Party (AP) from 1964 to 1980 and the leader of the True Path Party (DYP) from 1987 to 1993.

zh.t: 苏莱曼·德米雷尔就任土耳其总统
zh.s: 苏莱曼·萨米·德米雷尔（1924年11月1日—2015年6月17日）是土耳其政治家、工程师和国务活动家，1993年至2000年担任土耳其总统。此前，他在1965年至1993年间七次担任土耳其总理。他于1964年至1980年领导正义党（AP），并于1987年至1993年领导正确道路党（DYP）。

en.s: General elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 16 May 1994. Joaquín Balaguer of the Social Christian Reformist Party won the presidential election, whilst the Dominican Revolutionary Party-led alliance won the Congressional elections. Voter turnout was 87.6%. Despite reforms after the 1990 elections, including a new electoral roll, these elections were also branded fraudulent. Following the election an agreement known as the Pacto por la Democracia (Pact for Democracy) was reached, which shortened the presidential term to two years, allowing new elections to be held in 1996 in which Balaguer would not run (for the first time since 1966).

zh.s: 多米尼加共和国于1994年5月16日举行大选。社会基督教改革党候选人华金·巴拉格尔赢得总统选举，多米尼加革命党领导的联盟赢得国会选举。投票率为87.6%。尽管1990年选举后进行了改革，包括编制新的选民名册，这次选举仍被指存在舞弊。选举后，各方达成《民主协议》，将总统任期缩短至两年，并允许1996年重新举行选举；巴拉格尔将首次自1966年以来不再参选。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 16 May 1996, with a second round on 30 June. Whilst José Francisco Peña Gómez won the most votes in the first round, he was defeated by Leonel Fernández in the second after the Social Christian Reformist Party, whose candidate had lost in the first round, declared their support for Fernández.

zh.t: 1996年多米尼加共和国总统选举
zh.s: 多米尼加共和国于1996年5月16日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于6月30日举行。何塞·弗朗西斯科·佩尼亚·戈麦斯在首轮中得票最多，但在第二轮中败给莱昂内尔·费尔南德斯。首轮落败候选人所属的社会基督教改革党随后宣布支持费尔南德斯。

en.s: General elections were held in Gibraltar in May 1996. They were won by Peter Caruana's Gibraltar Social Democrats (GSD), who took over 50% of the popular vote and eight of the 15 contested seats, defeating incumbent Joe Bossano's Gibraltar Socialist Labour Party.

zh.s: 直布罗陀于1996年5月举行大选。彼得·卡鲁阿纳领导的直布罗陀社会民主党获胜，得票超过50%，并在15个争夺席位中赢得8席，击败时任首席部长乔·博萨诺领导的直布罗陀社会主义工党。

en.s: The 1997 Iraqi Perseverance Cup (Arabic: كأس المثابرة العراقي 1997) was the 2nd edition of the Iraqi Super Cup. zh.s: 1997年伊拉克坚忍杯是伊拉克超级杯的第二届赛事。比赛于1997年5月16日在巴格达人民体育场举行，由巴格达两支宿敌空军队和扎瓦拉队对阵，为1996—1997赛季收官。空军队以3比1获胜，成为首支在国内实现四冠王的伊拉克球队。

en.s: The 1998 FA Cup final was a football match between Arsenal and Newcastle United on 16 May 1998 at the old Wembley Stadium, London. Six-time winners Arsenal were appearing in their thirteenth final, whereas Newcastle United, having also won the competition six times, appeared in their eleventh final.

zh.s: 1998年英格兰足总杯决赛于1998年5月16日在伦敦旧温布利球场举行，由阿森纳对阵纽卡斯尔联。这是1997—1998赛季英格兰足总杯的决赛，也是这项世界历史最悠久的足球淘汰赛第117个赛季的决胜战。曾六次夺冠的阿森纳第13次闯入决赛，纽卡斯尔联同样曾六次夺冠，这是他们第11次进入决赛。

en.s: The 1998 Scottish Cup Final was played on 16 May 1998 at Celtic Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 113th Scottish Cup. Heart of Midlothian and Rangers contested the match which Hearts won 2–1, thanks to Colin Cameron's early penalty and Stephane Adam's goal. zh.s: 1998年苏格兰杯决赛于1998年5月16日在格拉斯哥凯尔特人公园球场举行，是第113届苏格兰杯决赛。对阵双方是哈茨队和流浪者队，哈茨凭科林·卡梅伦开场不久的点球和斯特凡·亚当的进球，以2比1获胜。这也是阿利·麦考伊斯特代表流浪者队的最后一场比赛；他替补登场后为球队打入一球。

en.s: The 1998 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1997–98 DFB-Pokal, the 55th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 16 May 1998 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Bayern Munich won the match 2–1 against MSV Duisburg to claim their ninth cup title.

zh.s: 1998年德国杯决赛决出了1997—1998赛季德国顶级足球淘汰赛的冠军，是德国杯第55个赛季的决胜战。比赛于1998年5月16日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。拜仁慕尼黑以2比1击败杜伊斯堡，赢得队史第九个德国杯冠军。

en.s: The 1998 National Soccer League Grand Final was held on 16 May 1998 between South Melbourne and Carlton SC at Olympic Park Stadium. South Melbourne gained home advantage as they won the major semi-final against them two weeks earlier. John Anastasiadis scored in the ninth minute for South Melbourne as they went up 1–0 at the half time break.

zh.s: 1998年全国足球联赛总决赛于1998年5月16日举行，由南墨尔本队对阵卡尔顿SC队，比赛场地为奥林匹克公园体育场。南墨尔本队在两周前的主要半决赛中击败卡尔顿，因而获得主场优势。第9分钟，约翰·阿纳斯塔西亚迪斯为南墨尔本队进球，上半场结束时球队以1比0领先。

zh.s: 1998年比利时杯决赛于1998年5月16日举行，由亨克队对阵布鲁日俱乐部队。这是比利时杯第43届决赛。亨克队首次闯入决赛，最终以4比0大胜。

en.s: Hardcore Heaven (1999) was the fifth Hardcore Heaven professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event and the second to be broadcast on pay-per-view. en.s: On May 16, 2000, an election was held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor.. Incumbent mayor Vera Katz was re-elected to a third term. en.s: The 2000 Oregon Democratic presidential primary took place on May 16, 2000, in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election and was the only contest on that date. en.s: The 2001 UEFA Cup final was a football match between Liverpool of England and Alavés of Spain on 16 May 2001 at the Westfalenstadion in Dortmund, Germany. en.s: The 2003 Casablanca bombings were a series of suicide bombings on May 16, 2003, in Casablanca, Morocco. The attacks were the deadliest terrorist attacks in the country's history. Forty-five people were killed in the attacks (33 victims and 12 suicide bombers). The suicide bombers came from the shanty towns of Sidi Moumen, a poor suburb of Casablanca.

en.s: A presidential election was held in the Dominican Republic on 16 May 2008. A poll from late October 2007 gave the incumbent Leonel Fernández of the centre-right Dominican Liberation Party 42%, construction tycoon Miguel Vargas Maldonado of the centre-left Dominican Revolutionary Party 30% and Amable Aristy Castro of the populist Social Christian Reformist Party 17%. A poll from mid-November 2007 saw Fernández at 40.1%, Vargas Maldonado at 30.5%, Aristy Castro at 17.2%, Eduardo Estrella of the Fourth Way at 1.5% and Pedro Candelier of the Popular Alliance Party at 1.1%.

en.s: A Legislative Assembly election was held on 16 May 2016 for the 232 seats (Except Thanjavur and Aravakurichi) of the Legislative Assembly in the state of Tamil Nadu in India. en.s: The 2016 Kerala Legislative Assembly election was held on 16 May 2016 to elect 140 MLAs to the 14th Kerala Legislative Assembly. Voter turnout was 77.53%, up from 75.12% in the previous election. The result was declared on 19 May 2016. The Left Democratic Front (LDF), led by Communist Party of India (Marxist) (CPI(M)), won the election, defeating the incumbent United Democratic Front (UDF), led by the Indian National Congress (INC), which could only win 47 seats in the election.

en.s: A major mutiny broke out among the army of Ivory Coast in January 2017. The mutineers, mostly ex-Forces Nouvelles de Côte d'Ivoire rebels who had been integrated into the armed forces in 2011, were motivated by grievances about their pay and living conditions. Seizing control of nine cities throughout the country, they pressured the government to accept their demands, whereupon the mutiny ended.

en.s: The 2018 Armenian Cup final was the 27th Armenian Cup Final, and the final match of the 2017–18 Armenian Cup. It was played at the Republican Stadium in Yerevan, Armenia, on 16 May 2018, and was contested by Gandzasar Kapan and Alashkert. It was played at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais in Décines-Charpieu, Lyon, France on 16 May 2018, between French side Marseille and Spanish side Atlético Madrid.

en.s: The 2019 Newfoundland and Labrador general election was held on May 16, 2019, to elect members of the 49th General Assembly of Newfoundland and Labrador. en.t: Football at the 2023 SEA Games – Men's tournament final
en.s: The men's football final at the 2023 Southeast Asian Games was the gold medal match between the under-22 teams of Indonesia and Thailand on May 16, 2023, at the Olympic Stadium in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. zh.s: 2023年东南亚运动会男子足球决赛是金牌赛，由印度尼西亚和泰国的U22队伍对阵。比赛于2023年5月16日在柬埔寨金边的奥林匹克体育场举行。印度尼西亚队在晋级过程中保持全胜，先以五连胜位居A组第一，随后在半决赛中击败卫冕冠军越南队。

en.s: The 2023 Anambra ambush was a violent attack on a United States consular convoy in the town of Atani, in Southeastern Nigeria. Though the attack caused multiple casualties, none were of American citizens as confirmed by both Nigerian and American authorities.

en.s: In the late evening hours of May 16, 2025, a large and deadly nocturnal EF4 tornado moved through the western Cumberland Plateau, impacting the Kentucky cities of Somerset and London. The tornado, which was on the ground for almost an hour and a half, killed 18 people and injured 108 others along a 60 mi (97 km) track.

en.s: On the afternoon of May 16, 2025, an intense, extremely large, and destructive tornado tracked for more than 12 miles (19 km) through urban areas of Greater St. Louis, including Greater Ville and Fountain Park, in the U.S. state of Missouri. The massive and rainwrapped EF3 tornado, which was 1.8 mi (2.9 km) wide at its largest, inflicted widespread destruction across St. Louis, Missouri.

zh.s: 2025年5月16日下午，一场强烈、规模巨大且破坏性极强的龙卷风横扫美国密苏里州大圣路易斯地区，穿过大维尔和喷泉公园等城区，路径超过12英里（19公里）。这场被雨幕遮挡的EF3级龙卷风最宽处达1.8英里（2.9公里），给圣路易斯市造成大范围破坏。
